title: Agency & Partnership
description: Business Associations, Weeks 1–8 (Bainbridge, Park & Rodrigues, 6th ed.). Covers creating an agency, actual and apparent authority, ratification and estoppel, a principal's tort liability, agents' fiduciary duties, choosing an entity, partnership formation under the UPA and RUPA, partners' rights, authority and duties, dissociation and dissolution, loss sharing, buyout agreements, limited partnerships, and LLCs.

Agency_and_Partnership_Condensed_Outline.title: Agency & Partnership Outline
Agency_and_Partnership_Condensed_Outline.description: Condensed exam outline of Weeks 1–8, built from the Class 1–8 slides, the casebook, and the 2026 statutory supplement. Part I covers agency: creating the relationship, contract liability and authority, tort liability, and fiduciary duties. Part II covers business entities: choosing an entity, partnership formation, economic rights and property, management and authority, partners' fiduciary duties, dissociation and dissolution, Kovacik loss sharing, buyout agreements, limited partnerships, and LLCs. Rule and tip boxes throughout, and a card for every case (62 main cases plus slide references and supplemental readings).

Agency_and_Partnership_Bar_Questions.htm.title: Agency & Partnership Bar Questions
Agency_and_Partnership_Bar_Questions.htm.description: 284 bar-style multiple-choice questions covering every rule, case, and slide problem in the Weeks 1–8 outline, across 23 topics: creating an agency, actual, apparent and inherent authority, ratification, estoppel, agents' contract and tort liability, scope of employment, independent contractors, and agents' fiduciary duties; then entity selection, partnership formation, property, management and authority, partners' duties, dissociation and dissolution under the UPA and RUPA, loss sharing, buyouts, limited partnerships, LLPs, and LLCs. Each question sets out new facts, and every answer choice has its own explanation. Variations change one fact to test whether the result changes. Filter by topic, shuffle the questions or answers, retry the ones you missed, and use the coverage map to find the questions for any outline item.

Agency_and_Partnership_Practice_Exams.ht.title: Agency & Partnership Practice Exams
Agency_and_Partnership_Practice_Exams.ht.description: 14 practice exams (210 questions) for the Week 10 exam, written in the format of Professor Richardson's sample exam: 15 five-choice questions each, with six stand-alone questions followed by two shared hypos (Q7–11 and Q12–15), and combination choices such as "B and C", "A, B and C", and "None of the above." Together they cover all 14 sections of the Weeks 1–8 condensed outline, from creating an agency through authority, ratification, estoppel, tort liability, and agents' duties, to partnership formation, property, management, partners' duties, dissociation and dissolution under the UPA and RUPA, Kovacik loss sharing, buyouts, LPs, LLPs, and LLCs. Every choice has its own explanation. Study mode checks each answer as you pick it; Exam mode lets you answer a full exam and then grade it. Filter by exam or outline section, shuffle the questions, and retry the ones you missed.

Welcome_to_the_Fortress.mp3.title: Welcome to the Fortress
Welcome_to_the_Fortress.mp3.description: A study song for outline sections 13 and 14: limited partnerships, LLCs, and veil piercing. Covers general partners' unlimited liability and limited partners' shield, the corporate general partner in Frigidaire v. Union Properties, LLCs as creatures of contract under the ULLCA, member-managed and manager-managed LLCs, and veil piercing as the only way through the liability shield. Play it at 0.5×, 0.75×, normal, 1.25×, or 1.5× speed.
